fn parents() {
    let d = std::env::current_exe().unwrap().parent().unwrap().parent().unwrap().to_path_buf();
}

fn split_over_lines() {
    let out = PathBuf::from(env!("OUT_DIR"))
        .parent()
        .unwrap()
        .parent()
        .unwrap();
}

fn dots() {
    let d = std::env::current_exe().unwrap().join("../..");
    let e = Path::new(env!("OUT_DIR")).join("..").join("..");
}

fn literal() {
    let p = root.join("target/debug/deps/foo");
    let w = r"C:\build\debug\deps\foo.exe";
    let q = base.join("deps");
    let mut v = PathBuf::new();
    v.push("deps");
}
